diagnosis.failure_mode: The advantages are being computed or normalized in a way that makes them effectively zero throughout training. This causes the policy gradient to be zero (policy_loss ≈ 0), preventing any policy updates. The policy remains at its initialization (uniform random with entropy = ln(2) ≈ 0.693), while the value function continues to learn normally since it uses actual returns rather than advantages. Evidence: policy_loss is ~1e-7 (essentially zero), approx_kl is exactly 0.0 (no policy change), clipfrac is 0.0 (no gradients to clip), and entropy remains constant at ln(2) throughout all 100 iterations, while explained_variance increases from 0.005 to 0.42 showing the value function is learning.
